item.title: Three LSMSA student-athletes earn LHSAA Academic All-State Honors (2026-11-13)
item.description: Three students from the Louisiana School for Math, Science, and the Arts (LSMSA) have earned Louisiana High School Athletic Association (LHSAA) Academic All-State honors, demonstrating that academic excellence and competitive athletics can go hand in hand.
